chat.notes: Model references and LoRA adapters apply to the local llama.cpp provider only. A remote provider loads its own weights, so this Tool cannot attach an adapter to it.

gguf-model.label: GGUF model for llama.cpp
gguf-model.notes: A single .gguf file. Its header is read to confirm the format; compatibility with a given adapter is still decided by the loader.

gguf-lora.label: GGUF LoRA adapter for llama.cpp
gguf-lora.notes: A .gguf whose metadata declares adapter.type=lora. Converted from a PEFT adapter with convert_lora_to_gguf.py, or downloaded already converted. llama.cpp refuses an adapter whose tensors do not match the loaded model.
